skill_name: Describe the effects of a four year economic recession on a small business.
workflow: A four year economic recession can have devastating effects on a small business. Cash flow problems can arise if orders drop off, inventory costs can increase, and costumers may become more risk-adverse causing their spending habits to change. As result, a small business may experience a decrease in their customer base, which can lead to a decrease in revenue.
